cases.title: Catalog API with Elasticsearch banned

cases.title: Self-host Dify on ACK in Frankfurt

defects: Dify node should sit inside the ACK cluster (edge from ACK is present, but Dify is drawn as a separate VPC node rather than clearly on the cluster); minor ambiguity.
NAT Gateway justification is slightly off: Model Studio is a regional Alibaba service reachable without internet egress; NAT is only needed if public endpoints are used.

reasons: Covers all requested components: Dify on ACK in Frankfurt, Model Studio for Qwen, OSS for documents, plus RDS metadata DB and Tair cache as Dify requires.
Placement follows the rules: OSS/SLS/Model Studio outside the VPC, DNS not a data-path hop, multi-zone nodes as single nodes with zones a,b.
Drew first on stated assumptions and asked two relevant design-changing questions with quick replies.

cases.title: Live-streaming site DDoS chain order

cases.title: Private Jakarta databases for on-prem SaaS
